@@U04312@@
Therefore, and with no hesitation, I bind myself to you four worthy custodians of my house, my court, and my empire.

@@U04313@@
(To the FIRST PRINCE.)

@@U04314@@
It was you, prince, who shrewdly organized the army and struck out boldly when the moment was right. Do so as well in peace, for with this sword I invest you Lord Marshall.

@@U04316@@
Majesty, no sooner your borders are secured, and your person and throne once more safe, permit us with throngs of joyous friends to serve you at table, to bear before and hold beside you this radiant sword, forever your Highness’s escort.

@@U04318@@
(To the SECOND PRINCE.)

@@U04319@@
On you, sir, a man of courage and gentle demeanor, I bestow the title of Lord Chamberlain. Your task is no easy one. Your jurisdiction is over the domestic staff, where, it is not unknown to me, there is no small discontent and inefficiency. It is yours to serve as model of how one tends one’s liege, one’s court, and one’s fellows.

@@U04321@@
To serve your noble person does me grace, Sire. To help the good and not to harm the base, to be open, honest, and calm without deceit is all my desire. And if you see me, Highness, for what I am, my joy could not be greater. Already I look forward to the feast. At table I will offer the golden bowl,
translation:
@@U04312@@
因此，我毫不犹豫地将自己与你们联系在一起，你们是我的家族、我的宫廷和我的帝国的四位值得尊敬的守护者。

@@U04313@@
（致第一王子。）

@@U04314@@
是王子您精明地组织军队，并在时机成熟时大胆出击。也请安静地这样做，因为我将这把剑授予您马歇尔勋爵。

@@U04316@@
陛下，一旦您的边境安全，您的人身和王位再次安全，请允许我们与一群快乐的朋友一起在餐桌上为您服务，将这把光芒四射的剑放在您面前并保持在您身边，永远为殿下护航。

@@U04318@@
（对二皇子。）

@@U04319@@
先生，您是一位勇敢、举止温和的人，我授予您宫内大臣的称号。你的任务并不容易。你们的管辖范围是家政人员，我并不陌生，那里存在着不小的不满和低效率。你应该成为一个人如何照顾自己的领主、宫廷和同胞的典范。

@@U04321@@
为您的高贵之人服务是我的荣幸，陛下。济善而不害贱，开诚布公，淡定不欺，乃我所愿。殿下，如果您看到我的本来面目，我的喜悦就再大不过了。我已经开始期待这场盛宴了。餐桌上我将奉上金碗，
